fusions.name: Scale Shower
fusions.desc: Looses a cone of splintered shafts ahead of you, dealing 10 damage to everything caught in it and knocking each back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Ricochet Plate
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Curl Tight
fusions.desc: Gives you a shield that absorbs 24 damage across 4 hits for 8 seconds and raises your armour by 10%.

fusions.name: Overlapping Seams
fusions.desc: Your armour rises 10% and you regain 1 health a second.
